# Goal
Kake round 40, wave 1 (the adversarial control wave, run before the claimed build lands), plus source re-opens and attacks on the round's declaration. The L1 (agent id KakeR40) is the only integrator and scorer; you are one leaf seat. Lane repo: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin (tip f043c72146ddb7e3bb1c64d26fd5ae2b01b508f8). Lane axes: operability and freshness.

# The claim (frozen at f043c72146ddb7e3bb1c64d26fd5ae2b01b508f8; read /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/SCORECARD.md section "Round 40 — C1 declared")
C1 repairs `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/scripts/sitemap_audit.py` (contract /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-39/c1-contract.md) on three input classes: E (UTF-16 without a BOM → `xml_malformed`), U (a `loc` or `sitemapUrl` carrying TAB/CR/LF, or a `sitemapUrl` with a leading C0 control or space → `loc_not_absolute` / `check_invalid`), R (a check repeating the string id of an earlier invalid check → `check_invalid`). Frozen counter: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-40/c1_count.py (30 public witnesses with random hosts/ids per run, plus the round-39 selftest 150/150). Predicate: `met: passed >= 30 of 30 witnesses and the round-39 selftest passes 150 of 150`. The L1's reference repair (the build candidate, not yet in the lane) is at /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r40/shared/ref_fix.py, its diff against the base tool at /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r40/shared/ref_fix.diff (read-only). Kill rule: any CONTROL that meets the predicate before the build lands makes C1 exploratory. A control is a tool built to skip declared work (classes in the SCORECARD section). Finding a control that meets the predicate is a success for you, not a failure: report it plainly.

# Scoring a tool (control seats)
`timeout 1200 python3 -B /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-40/c1_count.py --root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin --tool-file <your tool> --label <YourName>[-suffix] --out <your sandbox>/receipt[-suffix].json` — exit 0 met, 1 not met, 2 cannot evaluate. The counter only reads the lane via read-only `git show`. Run it as often as you like; the L1 re-scores every tool you return.

# Bounds
- You are a leaf: no subagents, no swarm, no verdict on the round.
- Your ONLY write paths are your sandbox /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r40w1/<YourName>/ and your report file. Never mutate the fleet repo (/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin), sibling lanes, the lane jj state, the lane Git index or any lane file other than your report. Never edit files under /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r40/shared.
- Never run git add/commit/stash/checkout/reset/pull/push or any mutating jj command in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin; read-only git is fine. Never run jj at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin. If you need a clone: `git clone -q /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin /fast/scratch/hyaku/kake-r40w1/<YourName>/clone` after unsetting GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_INDEX_FILE.
- Cap every run with `timeout` (≤1200 s), ≤8 parallel processes, `prlimit --as=4000000000`; bound every file you write (≤200 MB per seat; never append in a loop to a file Python imports; never point a log at sitecustomize.py or a .pth); `df -h /fast` before writing >1 GB; kill every process tree you start before returning. Never run `du` or `find` over /fast/scratch as a whole.
- Network: only URLs your item names, GET only. Never request the operator's properties (ds4cc.com, app.ds4cc.com, operator *.onrender.com hosts, *.kimi.page, *.kimi.pro, veigapunk.github.io, any host in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/freshness-pins.json).
- Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kake-shokunin/<that path>.
- Tooling authorization (operator, 2026-10-19): you and every seat may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels; record tool, version, channel and reason in your report). All pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide (orchestrator ruling 2026-10-20): install via uv tool, npx or an official binary in ~/.local/bin; never pacman -S, -Sy, -Syu, -U or -R, no downgrade, no service restart.
- A provider safety or policy refusal or an automatic model switch ends your item: a one-line report saying so; do not rephrase. Message only agent://KakeR40 for blockers; never agent://all. Plain English.

# Result
Report under 60 lines: what you built or checked, exact commands with exit codes, tool paths with sha256, counter results (passed, byClass, selftest, met) for every tool you scored, findings with path:line, and per attacked statement: holds / overstated / wrong. An unrun check has not passed. Time box: 30 minutes; a partial report (first line `PARTIAL:`) beats none.
